verdict.pick: Reshoevn8r Premium Shoe Water & Stain Repellant
verdict.line: Picture a runner who wants to keep his white sneakers looking fresh after a rainy jog. Reshoevn8r offers the best water‑repelling protection and only 15 minutes of dry time, so he can get back on the track quickly. The catch: it is the most expensive spray tested.
